summary: Diff matches the task and ACCEPTANCE sections 2, 3 and 5. platform/dg_test_hooks.c has exactly six DG_TEST_ getters with the specified semantics: NULL mo returns 0, and fists/am_noammo return 0. The frame counter is incremented once in DG_DrawFrame and shared via an extern. build.sh uses set -euo pipefail, cds to its own directory, removes dist and build, compiles third_party/doomgeneric/*.c plus platform/*.c, and needs no network. The mus2mid main() is guarded by #ifdef STANDALONE, so there is no conflicting main. The output is doom.js, one doom.wasm and doom.data, with ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH, no MODULARIZE and no threads. index.html is copied from web/. I did not re-run the build; the controller's build gate already passed.

findings.summary: -w suppresses all compiler warnings, which could hide real porting problems in platform/ code later. Consider dropping it or applying it only to the engine sources.
